answer: Plant each identity as a willow: one key pair, rooted once, never cloned. The network then runs a whisper roll-call: at unpredictable times, every island cohort gets a fresh nonce whispered to its members, who must reply within minutes by signing the nonce plus a reference to their latest verified job. One honest agent answers easily, but a farmer steering dozens of fakes cannot attend simultaneous roll-calls across islands, and one hired responder for many identities betrays itself through identical timing and signatures. Missed calls shrink trust; repeated misses prune the branch.
